story.quote: “We wanted a home that could feel calm every day, welcome our extended family, and still remain connected to the garden. Katic helped us make each decision with confidence—from the first plan to the final material. The completed home feels generous without being excessive, and deeply personal without trying too hard.”

rows.title: The requirement
rows.text: A private family home that balanced togetherness and retreat, with natural light, garden views and practical space for multigenerational living.

rows.title: The design journey
rows.text: The plan evolved through close workshops around routines, privacy and material character. Architecture, interiors and site coordination moved as one conversation.

rows.title: The outcome
rows.text: A warm, light-filled residence with clear circulation, crafted details and flexible spaces that now support both quiet weekdays and large family gatherings.
